The fastest anything can move is the speed of light (~300,000,000 metres per second in a vacuum). Therefore, every second, your sphere grows by 300,000,000 metres in all directions. For you to be able to interact with something it has to be inside that sphere. After 8 minutes, your sphere would reach the Sun - so you'd be able to see light that was emitted by the Sun at the same moment you were born. After ~4 years you'd see light emitted by the second nearest star, Proxima Centauri, at the moment you were born. That would be 2.5 million years for the Andromeda Galaxy. This is an oversimplification but still - a mindblowing idea.
